verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a single-command scaffold for creating a first agent and a browser-based Studio at localhost:4111 for testing agents. Neither is a documented way to run example agents headlessly from a terminal. Studio is an interactive visual UI, scaffolding is not execution, and deploying a server is at most a developer building block, so none of these earns credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can run the framework's example agents headlessly from a terminal so an agent can verify what it just built
